title: Investigate the H3 w4a8 DiTs - is there a real win, and where do they land?
description: Kijai published w4a8_mixed builds of both H3 DiTs (fl2va 12.54GB, ref2va 11.77GB, vs 20.97GB int8_convrot each). Fabio ran one generation with the fl2va build and did NOT see much speed difference, so the win is unproven - investigate before deciding anything. Likely home if it ships is the Model Library quality tier. BLOCKED on the 1.4 release and on GPU availability (a Cubric-Prompt agent has it).
